events.title: GDGoC LDCE Orientation - 2025
events.description: The official orientation of GDGoC LDCE marked the beginning of our community journey. Students explored the GDGoC mission, yearly roadmap, Google Developer ecosystem, and upcoming opportunities for the academic cycle.

details.label: Venue
details.value: Vishwakarma Hall, LD College of Engineering

highlights.text: Launch of GDGoC LDCE
Yearly roadmap + upcoming events overview
Introduction to GDG ecosystem & student benefits
Community Q&A and interaction with the core team
Student feedback: inspiring, informative, and beginner-friendly
Roadmap clarity appreciated by attendees

events.title: Google Cloud Study Jam 2025 (Tier 1 Achieved)
events.description: A month-long, gamified cloud upskilling journey where students mastered Google Cloud fundamentals via labs, quests, and hands-on activities. Achieved Tier 1 status with standout completion and engagement metrics.

details.label: Houses
details.value: 7 (Alpha, Bravo, Charlie, Delta, Enigma, Falcon, Gamma)

highlights.text: Tier 1 status unlocked for GDGoC LDCE
Gamified houses kept engagement high
Mini challenge: Speedathon -🥇 Charlie, 🥈 Bravo, 🥉 Falcon
Mentorship support ensured badge completions
Student feedback: labs were practical & easy to follow

syllabus: The Basics of Google Cloud Compute
Get Started with Google Workspace Tools
Develop with Apps Script and AppSheet
Build a Website on Google Cloud
Set Up a Google Cloud Network
Store, Process, and Manage Data on GCP (Console)
Analyze Speech & Language with Google APIs
Develop GenAI Apps with Gemini & Streamlit

events.title: Hack and Learn AI
events.description: An interactive session designed for students and developers to build meaningful AI projects. Led by Krishna N. Mehta (Visa), the session focused on practical learning, hackathon strategies, and industry expectations rather than theory alone. Attendees gained insights into how AI is built, evaluated, and applied in the real world.

highlights.text: Deep dive into 'Build with AI' concepts
Strategies to perform better in hackathons
Real-world industry perspectives from Visa & Akamai experience
Bonus: Lovable Pro access + $25 credits provided to attendees

events.title: Hack and Learn Firebase
events.description: A comprehensive hands-on workshop led by Srushti Raybhoge, a Google Developer Expert (GDE) in Firebase. Participants dove deep into Firebase fundamentals, covering authentication, cloud storage, and database integration. The session provided practical exercises to help students master tools needed for building scalable applications.

highlights.text: Led by a Google Developer Expert (GDE) in Firebase
Hands-on exercises on Authentication & Database integration
Refined skills for building end-to-end applications
Interactive Q&A regarding scalable app development

events.title: TechSprint x LDCE Hackathon
events.description: An Open Innovation Hackathon that brought together 180 students from across the nation to ideate, design, and develop technology-driven solutions for real-world challenges, encouraging creativity, innovation, and problem-solving.

highlights.text: Two pre-mentoring expert sessions conducted by industry professionals.

Strengthened the campus technology ecosystem and nurtured future-ready developers.
